items.title: maintenanceClassicOct 21, 2026[Completed] Scheduled Grand Launch - October 21, 2026The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 5 hours.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
CLASSIC
Oct 21, 2026
[COMPLETED] SCHEDULED GRAND LAUNCH - OCTOBER 21, 2026

[Updated 10/21 at 11:00 AM PDT] The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 5 hours. Please restart your Nexon Launcher or Steam to ensure you receive the latest client update.

We will be performing a scheduled maintenance starting on Wednesday, October 21, 2026 at 6:00 AM PDT (9:00 AM EDT / 3:00 PM CEST / 12:00 AM AEDT October 22). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 5 hours, concluding around 11:00 AM PDT (2:00 PM EDT / 8:00 PM CEST / 5:00 AM AEDT October 22).

Times:

Wednesday, October 21, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 6:00 AM - 11:00 AM
EDT (UTC -4): 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM
CEST (UTC +2): 3:00 PM - 8:00 PM
AEDT (UTC +11): 12:00 AM October 22 - 5:00 AM October 22

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory Classic World game servers.

Changes and Updates:

MapleStory Classic World will be updated to v.1.0.0.
Monthly Windows Update.

Read the Grand Launch Release Notes HERE!
Expanded Windia to 40 channels.
Added Kerning City Party Quest (KPQ) to Channels 8–12.
Reduced the amount of Garnet Ore, Amethyst Ore, Aquamarine Ore, Emerald Ore, Opal Ore, Sapphire Ore, Topaz Ore, Diamond Ore, and Black Crystal Ore that can obtained from the Companion’s Magic Box from Kerning City Party Quest.
The Companion's Magic Box from Kerning City Party Quest now has a chance to drop the Lakelis Statue housing decoration.
Added The Murky Swamp II in the Kerning City area.
Added new quests in Victoria Island.
Added drop items for some monsters in Victoria Island.
Added Free Market Rooms 12–20.
Added a Rates Info button to probability-based items in the Cash Shop.
Added equipment bonus stats to appear in the Character Stats window.
Added an option in Settings to always display item names in English.
Adjusted field boss respawn times to be more randomized.
Increased the potion drop rate for monsters between Lv. 10 and 30.
The minimum damage required to stagger the following monsters was unintentionally set too low and has been corrected:
Copper Drake
Tortie
Drake
Red Drake
Wild Kargo
The level requirement for Megaphone items has been increased from 10 to 15. 

You can find the details of the Megaphone level requirements in the webpost HERE.
The Beauty Album can now be expanded by using Beauty Album Hair/Face Slot Films.
Skill changes:

Swordsman
HP Recovery from items: +5–20% → +20–50%
Iron Body: Weapon DEF: +5–25% → +20–40%
Magician
MP Recovery from items: +5–20% → +10–25%
Rogue
Dark Sight: Adjusted so that characters using Dark Sight appear semi-transparent to all players, including those outside their party.

Bug Fixes:

Resolved an issue where the rope leading to the top-right platform in The Murky Swamp could not be climbed.
Resolved an issue where players and monsters could move off-screen at the edges of Sleepy Dungeon II.
Resolved an issue where Final Attack would only last 30 seconds instead of 60 seconds for certain jobs.
Resolved an issue where Poison Breath would consume MP twice when hitting monsters.
Resolved an issue where Poison Breath would deal more than 1 damage to monsters immune to poison.
Resolved an issue where the Green Jester Hat was missing its +18 Magic Defense stat.
Resolved an issue where the 2nd Job advancement would fail and remove the quest item if there were not enough empty slots in the Use inventory.
Resolved an issue where pets using Auto Move and Expanded Auto Move would repeatedly try to pick up items on a different platform.
Resolved an issue where the Report window would not become transparent during combat even when UI Fade was enabled.
Resolved an issue where the game client would sometimes disconnect when editing a buddy’s memo after that buddy had logged out.
Resolved a text issue where “Account Friend” was misspelled in the Buddy List right-click menu.
items.bodyZh: 维护 经典 2026年10月21日 [已完成] 计划盛大上线 - 2026年10月21日 [10/21 上午11:00 PDT更新 (北京时间 2026年10月22日 凌晨2:00)] 维护已完成，我们已将您背包中的现金商城物品延长5小时。请重启Nexon Launcher或Steam以确保您收到最新的客户端更新。 我们将于2026年10月21日星期三上午6:00 PDT (北京时间 2026年10月21日 晚上9:00) 开始进行计划维护。预计维护将持续约5小时，于上午11:00 PDT (北京时间 2026年10月22日 凌晨2:00) 左右结束。 时间详情： 2026年10月21日，星期三 * 北京时间 (UTC +8): 10月21日 晚上9:00 - 10月22日 凌晨2:00 * 太平洋夏令时 (UTC -7): 上午6:00 - 上午11:00 * 东部夏令时 (UTC -4): 上午9:00 - 下午2:00 * 中欧夏令时 (UTC +2): 下午3:00 - 晚上8:00 * 澳大利亚东部夏令时 (UTC +11): 10月22日 凌晨12:00 - 10月22日 凌晨5:00 不可用内容： 所有MapleStory Classic World游戏服务器。 变更与更新： MapleStory Classic World将更新至v.1.0.0。 每月Windows更新。 在此处阅读盛大上线发布说明！ 将Windia扩展至40个频道。 在频道8–12添加了废弃都市组队任务（KPQ）。 降低了可从废弃都市组队任务的伙伴魔法箱中获得的石榴石矿石、紫水晶矿石、海蓝宝石矿石、绿宝石矿石、蛋白石矿石、蓝宝石矿石、黄玉矿石、钻石矿石和黑水晶矿石的数量。 废弃都市组队任务的伙伴魔法箱现在有几率掉落Lakelis雕像房屋装饰。 在废弃都市地区添加了浑浊沼泽II。 在维多利亚岛添加了新任务。 为维多利亚岛的部分怪物添加了掉落物品。 添加了自由市场房间12–20。 为现金商城中的概率类物品添加了概率信息按钮。 添加了装备附加属性显示在角色属性窗口中。 在设置中添加了始终以英文显示物品名称的选项。 调整了野外BOSS重生时间，使其更加随机化。 提高了10至30级怪物的药水掉落率。 以下怪物触发硬直所需的最低伤害被意外设置得过低，已修正： 铜龙 乌龟 龙 红龙 野卡戈 扩音器物品的等级要求从10级提高至15级。 您可以在网页帖子中查看扩音器等级要求的详细信息。 美容相册现在可以通过使用美容相册发型/脸型槽位胶片来扩展。 技能变更： 剑士 物品HP恢复：+5–20% → +20–50% 铁甲：武器防御：+5–25% → +20–40% 法师 物品MP恢复：+5–20% → +10–25% 盗贼 隐身：调整为使用隐身的角色对所有玩家呈现半透明状态，包括队伍外的玩家。 错误修复： 修复了通往浑浊沼泽右上平台的绳索无法攀爬的问题。 修复了玩家和怪物在瞌睡地牢II边缘可能移出屏幕的问题。 修复了某些职业的最终攻击仅持续30秒而非60秒的问题。 修复了毒雾在击中怪物时消耗两次MP的问题。 修复了毒雾对免疫中毒的怪物造成超过1点伤害的问题。 修复了绿色小丑帽缺少+18魔法防御属性的问题。 修复了当使用栏空格不足时，二转职业进阶会失败并移除任务物品的问题。 修复了使用自动移动和扩展自动移动的宠物会反复尝试拾取不同平台上的物品的问题。 修复了即使启用了UI淡出，举报窗口在战斗中也不会变为透明的问题。 修复了好友登出后编辑好友备注时游戏客户端有时会断开连接的问题。 修复了好友列表右键菜单中“账号好友”拼写错误的文本问题。

items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Oct 21, 2026
MAC OS BETA KNOWN ISSUES AND UPDATES

The macOS Beta update list focuses on all changes and updates for macOS users during the Beta service. Please check the Known Issues section below for any current issues affecting the macOS Beta, and the Updates section for what was updated and changed. Make sure to close and restart your client after an update to ensure you are on the latest build.

Known Issues:
MacOS users who have updated to macOS 27 Golden Gate are unable to access MapleStory through Steam.
We advise players to download and install MapleStory directly from the Nexon Launcher, which will prompt the Rosetta install needed to access the game. Once Rosetta is installed, MapleStory can be accessed from Steam as normal.
Some players have reported experiencing drop in FPS while playing through the macOS client.
We recommend turning off all in-game sound related settings as it may help alleviate this issue.
The macOS keyboard shortcut Cmd+M can be activated while playing with 'Auto Key Activation' enabled, causing the game client to minimize.
Updates:

October 21, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.39.
Resolved an issue where the Nexon launcher window would not restore when clicking its icon after being minimized.
Resolved an issue where the 'close app' button was unavailable on the Steam launcher.
Resolved an issue where Game Key Mode would not function when launching through Steam.
MapleStory Classic World:
Resolved a full-screen display issue that occurred on certain screen aspect ratios when launching through Steam.

October 5, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.38.
Added support for MapleStory Classic World on Nexon launcher.
Added support for MapleStory Classic World on Steam launcher.
Added Game Key Mode.

August 4, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.32.
MapleStory Classic World:

Resolved an issue where the top menu bar appeared in full-screen mode on certain non-widescreen monitors
Resolved an issue causing game controller malfunctions

July 14, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.31.
Minor adjustments to client stability.

July 9, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.30.
Resolved an issue where launching MapleStory through Steam would incorrectly display black borders.

June 17, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.28.
Updated to support Discord Connect feature for macOS.

June 4, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.27.
Resolved an issue where the background for the End User License Agreement was discolored when installing through Steam.
Resolved an issue where the error message for having an outdated client would not show when launching through Steam.

May 21, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.26.
Adjusted for Steam Client Support.

April 30, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.25.
Resolved an issue where a prompt would not show properly in dark mode during the first install.

April 9, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.24.
Resolved an issue where jumping would persist when repeating commands.
Adjusted the Dock Icon and Menu Bar.

February 4, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.21.
NGS will be updated to 5.3.38.0.

December 19, 2025

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.20.
Resolved an issue where there was a discrepancy with available disc space after installation

items.title: maintenanceOct 20, 2026v.271 Known IssuesHere you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.271 - MapleStory x Frieren: Beyond Journey's End update.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Oct 20, 2026
V.271 KNOWN ISSUES

The Known Issues section focuses on the major issues that have significantly impacted the game and community, and which our team is actively addressing. Please note that while we aim to cover the most impactful issues, this list will not encompass every reported issue. Check back regularly for updates on the status of these issues and information on resolved issues, or any new issues that may have been added.

Here you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.271 - MapleStory x Frieren: Beyond Journey's End update:

KNOWN ISSUES:
We have identified an issue where using Group Chairs may intermittently cause problems. Group Chairs will be disabled until the next maintenance.
Kazax's Energy Fragments and Inspector Boxes obtained from the Ride or Die event could not be opened even though the items had not expired.
For affected players, these items will be compensated in a future maintenance.
MacOS users who have updated to macOS 27 Golden Gate are unable to access MapleStory through Steam.
We advise players to download and install MapleStory directly from the Nexon Launcher, which will prompt the Rosetta install needed to access the game. Once Rosetta is installed, MapleStory can be accessed from Steam as normal.
RESOLVED ISSUES:

October 20, 2026

Text updated to “Claim Designer EXP” in the Activate Virtual Training mini-game to clarify that Designer EXP must be claimed.

October 13, 2026

Resolved an issue where players were unable to enter the Yeti’s Night event map.

October 12, 2026

Resolved an issue where Grandis Daily Quests did not grant Sol Erda rewards upon choosing not to collect the Grandis Symbol.
Affected players will receive the missing Sol Erda rewards during a future maintenance.

September 30, 2026

Resolved an issue where the Information Viewer '?' button in the [Night Troupe] Mesotron-S Project event displayed a 404 error.

September 21, 2026

Resolved an issue where some players were unable to World Leap due to pending Meso Market Transactions.
Meso or Maple Points for affected players will be distributed at a later date. 

September 17, 2026

Resolved an issue where Night Lord and Ren characters would disconnect when entering Phase 3 of Kaling.
Resolved an issue where the Symbol Selector Coupon's item description incorrectly displays as "Sacred Symbol Selector Coupons x2" instead of x1.
Resolved an issue where some players were unable to World Leap from Challenger World.
Resolved an issue where some players were unable to World Leap due to an error stating "You haven't checked the results of your previously registered Mystic Frontier Champion Lineup yet. Check the results first."
Resolved an issue where Princess No would not attack.
Resolved an issue where the Guild Board UI contained untranslated text.
Resolved an issue where Sacred Symbol Selectors obtained from the Weekly Guild Castle Missions could not be used.
Resolved an issue where the Frieren NPC text titles contained Spanish text.
Resolved an issue where after using Mercedes's Spirit of Elluel skill, the cooldown would not decrease after using a linked skill.
Resolved an issue where Demon Avenger characters interacting with Mastema during a Job Advancement quest could cause the client to disconnect.
Resolved an issue where Sol Hecate would stop attacking after using Phlegethon while Styx was bound to the Terms and Conditions.
Resolved an issue where the client would sometimes disconnect when using Star Cores on Gollux Gear in Veritas.
Resolved an issue where the Guiding Stars link skill would not properly apply when logging in.
Resolved an issue where the Power Cycle in Phase 2 of First Adversary message contained untranslated text.
Resolved an issue where the Legion buff item icons incorrectly displayed "Union" instead of "Legion".
Resolved an issue where the Animation toggle effects were reversed in the Enhance UI.
Resolved an issue where Erel characters could not add the Tree of Stars skill to their Buff Favorites UI.
Resolved an issue where the Random Mimic Box obtained from the 'Adventure with Frieren's Companions' event displayed an incorrect description.
Resolved an issue where characters who have not completed Monster Park Extreme are unable to use the Monster Park Extreme Express Pass Ticket.

September 18, 2026

Resolved an issue where Erel Light characters were unable to start the 2nd Job Advancement quest. Players who were unable to complete the 2nd Job Advancement can do so through the Maple Administrator.

September 10, 2026

Resolved an issue where Glowing Cubes were not working as intended when used on Hats with Legendary Potential after the v271 Patch. Potential resets using Cubes has been re-enabled.
Glowing Cubes used on Hats with Legendary Potential after the v.271 patch and before Potential resets were temporarily disabled have been distributed via the Gift Drop and can be claimed for three weeks. Glowing Cubes are untradable and have a 30-day duration.
Resolved an issue where the key binds would overlap when assigning a new key bind to quickslot UI.
Resolved an issue where players would disconnect from client when using Ascent skills in Black Mage.

September 9, 2026

Tallahart Fantasia Check-In Event
Players who were unable to check in at 55 and 56 check-ins during the Fantasia Finale week will have their missed rewards distributed via Maple Administrator following the maintenance on September 9, 2026.
Resolved an issue where some players were unable to purchase a Kinetic Pass.
The Kinetic event has been extended until September 15, 2026 at 11:59 PM UTC and can be accessed by talking to Maple Administrator.

维护
2026年10月12日
V.271 已知问题

已知问题部分主要关注对游戏和社区产生重大影响、且我们团队正在积极处理的问题。请注意，虽然我们力求涵盖影响最大的问题，但此列表不会包含所有已报告的问题。请定期查看，以获取这些问题的最新状态、已解决问题以及可能新增问题的相关信息。

以下为 v.271 - 冒险岛 x 葬送的芙莉莲 更新中的已知问题和已解决问题列表：

已知问题：
我们已确认使用组队椅子时可能间歇性出现问题。组队椅子将在下次维护前禁用。
从 Ride or Die 活动中获得的 Kazax's Energy Fragments 和 Inspector Boxes 即使未过期也无法打开。
对于受影响的玩家，这些物品将在未来的维护中补偿。
已更新至 macOS 27 Golden Gate 的 MacOS 用户无法通过 Steam 访问冒险岛。
我们建议玩家直接从 Nexon Launcher 下载并安装冒险岛，这将提示安装访问游戏所需的 Rosetta。安装 Rosetta 后，即可正常通过 Steam 访问冒险岛。
已解决问题：

2026年10月12日

修复了 Grandis 日常任务在选择不收集 Grandis Symbol 时不给予 Sol Erda 奖励的问题。
受影响的玩家将在未来的维护中收到缺失的 Sol Erda 奖励。

2026年9月21日

受影响玩家的枫币或枫叶点数将在稍后发放。

2026年9月17日

修复了夜行者和 Erel 角色在进入 Kaling 第三阶段时断开连接的问题。
修复了符号选择券的物品描述错误显示为“Sacred Symbol Selector Coupons x2”而非 x1 的问题。
修复了部分玩家无法从 Challenger World 进行世界飞跃的问题。
修复了部分玩家因错误提示“You haven't checked the results of your previously registered Mystic Frontier Champion Lineup yet. Check the results first.”而无法进行世界飞跃的问题。
修复了 Princess No 不攻击的问题。
修复了公会公告板 UI 包含未翻译文本的问题。
修复了从每周公会城堡任务获得的 Sacred Symbol Selectors 无法使用的问题。
修复了 Frieren NPC 文本标题包含西班牙语文本的问题。
修复了使用 Mercedes 的 Spirit of Elluel 技能后，使用链接技能时冷却时间不减少的问题。
修复了 Demon Avenger 角色在职业进阶任务中与 Mastema 互动时可能导致客户端断开连接的问题。
修复了 Sol Hecate 在 Styx 绑定至 Terms and Conditions 时使用 Phlegethon 后停止攻击的问题。
修复了在 Veritas 中对 Gollux 装备使用 Star Cores 时客户端有时会断开连接的问题。
修复了 Guiding Stars 链接技能在登录时无法正确应用的问题。
修复了 First Adversary 第二阶段 Power Cycle 消息包含未翻译文本的问题。
修复了联盟增益物品图标错误显示为“Union”而非“Legion”的问题。
修复了增强 UI 中动画切换效果反转的问题。
修复了 Erel 角色无法将 Tree of Stars 技能添加到增益收藏 UI 的问题。
修复了从“Adventure with Frieren's Companions”活动中获得的 Random Mimic Box 显示错误描述的问题。
